_systems_without_central_board.State University of New York System: No central ATS (suny.edu/careers is the ADP board of System Administration only); campuses use Interview Exchange / PeopleAdmin / NeoGov / Breezy individually. 13 campuses had inherited a cnycentral.com news article and are fixed above.
_systems_without_central_board.University of California: No central ATS; jobs.universityofcalifornia.edu only links campuses. Most campuses are on careerspub.universityofcalifornia.edu (PeopleSoft TAM) with a campus node + SiteId (ucb=21, ucdavis=7, ucsb, ucsd, ucsc, ucr, ucm); UCI/UCLA on iCIMS, UCSF own site.
_systems_without_central_board.North Carolina Community College System: No central board; nccommunitycolleges.edu/about-us/jobs/ lists only system-office jobs. Colleges use NeoGov/PeopleAdmin individually (all already resolved).
_systems_without_central_board.Washington State Board for Community and: No central board; ctcLink (hcprd.ctclink.us PeopleSoft) hosts many colleges with a SiteId each, others use NeoGov. All resolved.
_systems_without_central_board.Wisconsin Technical College System: No central board (wtcsystem.edu has none); colleges on Workday/iCIMS/NeoGov individually.
_systems_without_central_board.Florida State Board of Education / Flori: No central board. Sector-4 'technical colleges' are K-12 district schools (Broward, OCPS, Hillsborough, Miami-Dade, Pasco, Sarasota, Escambia...) hiring through district ATSes.
_systems_without_central_board.Pennsylvania State System of Higher Educ: No central board (passhe.edu TLS fails for scripts); universities use NeoGov/PeopleAdmin/CSOD individually. IUP and the system office inherited esu.csod.com (East Stroudsburg) which is wrong; IUP's own board could not be located (jobs.iup.edu down).
_systems_without_central_board.Massachusetts Community Colleges: No central board; Interview Exchange per college (BHCC = bhcc.interviewexchange.com 450BHM1, added above).
_systems_without_central_board.Montana University System: No central board; MSU campuses on PeopleAdmin (jobs.montana.edu, employment.msubillings.edu, jobs.gfcmsu.edu, jobs.msun.edu), UM affiliates on schooljobs.com/careers/ummissoula.
_systems_without_central_board.Texas community college districts / Flor: No statewide boards found (checked state association/board sites); colleges post individually.
_systems_without_central_board.Oklahoma Department of Career and Techno: No central board; tech centers use Frontline AppliTrack or PowerSchool TalentEd individually (added above).
_systems_without_central_board.University of Puerto Rico: No central board found (upr.edu/recursos-humanos has no listings); campuses publish convocatorias as PDFs; only UPR-Mayaguez (uprm.edu/empleos/en/) has a scrapeable list (already generic).
